text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the lesson studio, 
Bamboo Memory was practicing her dance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! Hmph, hmph, hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And strike a pose right here!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her precise, spirited choreography and 
determined gaze captivate everyone 
watching. However—
choice_data_list:
That choreography for such a light and 
breezy song is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I-It doesn't suit me...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The dance instructor pointed it out too, 
so I was trying really hard to fix it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try, it feels 
the same, and I just can't get close to 
the image of the song...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Guhhhhh! What am I supposed to do?!
choice_data_list: Relax and loosen up those shoulders.

I'll try copying someone who'd make a good 
role model.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Relaxing, ss? Like what, for example...?
choice_data_list:
How about trying to remember something 
fun?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Something fun, something fun... Guhhh... 
I mean, I know there must be a bunch of 
things, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is totally agonizing over 
this. If it's come to thisâ
choice_data_list: Then I'll come up with something fun!
Then I'll make something fun happen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After covering her face with both hands 
and making a funny face, she let go of her 
hands again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Heh-heh-heh... What's with that look 
on your face, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Did you like my special funny face?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not that I took a liking to it, 
exactly... It's just—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! That was totally out of 
nowhere! That's a foul, totally a foul!!
choice_data_list: There's another side to me, you know

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gyah! Please stop! My abs can't take any 
more!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps thanks to shaking off the tension 
nicely, Bamboo Memory seemed able to dance 
to the song's image afterward."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see, so we're starting with appearances 
first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Among the people I know... I guess 
Oguri-senpai would be a great role model?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The way you're always so natural and 
relaxed fits the vibe of the test song 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When we're together, there's this 
laid-back vibe, and I often end up going 
at Senpai's pace. But honestly, I don't 
mind it one bit!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It's the same in races! She's so 
completely free, so fast, and she just 
grabs your heart and won't let go...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If she runs like that, then I... I'll have 
to...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Guh... Uwoooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking about you, Senpai, made me 
desperately want to run...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! I'm gonna go run and burn 
off all this energy real quick!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory ran off toward the 
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it wasn't what I had originally 
planned, releasing her pent-up energy 
allowed her to loosen up just enough to 
dance in sync with the song.
